policy: Disclosure-safe outward-rounded WAS wealth support bounds for the UK support gate. STATUS: the committed values are pre-acceptance placeholders chosen without reference to licensed data; the E5 licensed acceptance run must regenerate them (tools/build_uk_was_wealth_support_bounds.py) from donor-realized exact ranges, rounded outward to 1-2 significant figures so unit-record minima and maxima are never committed, and the regenerated values are subject to reviewer sign-off.

source.sdc_treatment: Exact donor min/max values are rounded outward to 1-2 significant figures before commit.
